TODAY
The page as it stands, with the four duplications marked 1–4. The legend at the bottom of the board explains each one.

B · CHANNEL HUB — recommended
One card per channel. The card's own button is either Connect or Manage, so there is exactly one connect affordance per channel and no global one.
Kills: metric cards, tab bar, dead-end modal, both duplicate headers.
Tradeoff: Manage navigates to that channel's own page — returning is one back-click.

A · SINGLE SURFACE
No tabs. Six channel buttons open each connect flow in place; Manage opens a slide-over instead of a page.
Kills: every duplicate path and header; shortest click path.
Tradeoff: biggest refactor — all six channel pages must work inside a drawer.

C · RAIL + DETAIL
A left channel rail replaces both the metric cards and the tab bar. The rail selection is the title, so the embedded page's own header is suppressed.
Kills: metric/tab duplication and the second header.
Tradeoff: keeps the page-inside-a-page pattern; narrower content area.

D · SURGICAL FIX
Keep the tabs. Delete the metric cards, fold counts into the tabs, drop the dead-end modal, hide embedded sub-headers, add TikTok everywhere it is missing.
Kills: the duplication, with the smallest diff.
Tradeoff: information architecture unchanged — still a page inside a page, and the tab bar crowds as channels grow.
